page.overview:
What is Impedimenta?

The Impediment Jinx was a jinx that hindered the movement of the target, slowing it down or stopping it in its tracks.

The Impediment Jinx stopped or slowed down people or creatures, temporarily immobilising an attacker and offering the caster a chance to escape. It was even capable of freezing a wasp in mid-air.

However, the effect was only temporary, Additionally, even though it was effective against most animals and people, it was ineffective against armoured creatures, such as Acromantulas and Blast-Ended Skrewts. Unless the caster managed to hit them on their underbellies, which have no protective armour. It was also useless against enemies that had no physical corporeal form, such as lethifolds.

While the jinx would usually simply immobilise a target, it could also be used to push or throw a target backward, or simply decrease the velocity of the victim's movement.
